summary: 当晚 ACDC #181 确认 glamsterdam-devnet-6 已上线（除 EIP-7688 外的剩余 EIP 全部加入），devnet-7 目标 2 到 3 周后，加入 EIP-7688 和更新后的 EIP-8282 合约（需外部安全审查），并拒绝把 EIP-8080 纳入 Glamsterdam。misilva73 对 EIP-2780 合并两项修改，明确 gas 不足以支付新账户状态费用或委托收款方额外冷访问费用时按 OOG 处理；另提交 EIP-7999 扩展为四个资源维度。ethereum 官方账号转发 ameensol 关于 Alex Pertsev 案的长帖。

items.topic: 交易固有 gas 与多维定价
items.title: EIP-2780：澄清顶层收费的 OOG 处理
items.note: （misilva73）提交并合并：交易的 gas 够付固有成本但不够付执行期间的顶层收费（新账户状态费，或委托收款方额外的 `COLD_ACCOUNT_ACCESS`）时，由于这些收费在 EIP-7702 授权之后计算且需要读状态，按异常停止处理，交易被包含并回滚，而不是无效，交易有效性仍可不读状态判定。
items.title_en: EIP-2780: clarify OOG handling for top-level gas charges
items.note_en: (misilva73), submitted and merged: when a transaction has enough gas for its intrinsic cost but not for the top-level charges applied during execution (the new-account state charge, or the extra `COLD_ACCOUNT_ACCESS` for a delegated recipient), since these are evaluated after EIP-7702 authorizations and need state access, it is treated as an exceptional halt: the transaction is included and reverted, not invalidated, and validity stays decidable without state.

items.title: EIP-7999：加入数据和状态资源，简化 gas 计算
items.note: （misilva73）提交，从执行、blob 三个维度扩展为四个：数据资源按 EIP-8131 内容字节和 EIP-8279 BAL 字节计价，固定 `DATA_GAS_LIMIT = 60M`，去掉 EIP-7623 下限；状态增长成为单独计价的维度。
items.title_en: EIP-7999: add data and state resources, simplify gas accounting
items.note_en: (misilva73), submitted, expanding from three resource dimensions to four: a data resource priced from EIP-8131 content bytes and EIP-8279 BAL bytes with a flat `DATA_GAS_LIMIT = 60M`, dropping EIP-7623 floor pricing, and state growth as a separately priced dimension.

keywords_en: devnet-7 adds EIP-7688 and the updated EIP-8282
EIP-2780 OOG handling for top-level charges
Tornado Cash and the Pertsev case
summary_en: In the evening ACDC #181 confirmed glamsterdam-devnet-6 is live (with all remaining EIPs except EIP-7688), targeted devnet-7 in 2 to 3 weeks with EIP-7688 and the updated EIP-8282 contracts (external security review required), and declined EIP-8080 for Glamsterdam. misilva73 merged two EIP-2780 changes, specifying that running out of gas for the new-account state charge or the extra cold access for a delegated recipient is treated as OOG, and submitted an expansion of EIP-7999 to four resource dimensions. The official ethereum account shared ameensol's thread on Alex Pertsev's case.
